about: One camp, as /en/studio is one studio, after the hero: the founder's Nano Banana render (assets/camp/hero-gemini.jpeg, 2026-10-27), itself made from the footage's tent (public/footage/IMG_3172). A hexagonal pop-up pitched straight on the grass, its door rolled up, furnished as a floor lounge for two. The 2D (camp-plan.tsx) and the 3D (scripts/site/render/camp.html) both read this file. Plan in metres: x to the right, y toward the door, the tent's centre at 0,0. Furniture sizes are read off the render, not sourced.

tent.about: Hexagonal pop-up, flat sides front and back, the door the whole front side, rolled up to a strap at the top. 2.8 m across the corners (today's tents look about 2.5 m), walls standing to the shoulder, hips up to a small six-sided top, poles outside each corner.

rug.about: Striped flat-weave in rust, orange, teal and cream, in the middle of the floor.

floorChair.about: A legless floor chair in tan linen, back to the back-left wall, facing the door.

throw.about: A folded wool throw with a fringe, on the floor inside the door, left.

futon.about: A white quilted floor mattress along the right wall, a patterned cushion standing at its back end.

pillow.about: Patterned cushion, cream with a brown geometric band.

cushions.about: Two square quilted floor cushions stacked, front right.

tray.about: A timber tea board on the rug: a clay teapot and two cups.

lantern.about: A brass hurricane lantern on the floor at the back, lit.
